node.title: Pay pencil-free penultimate enclosures with inherited normalization
node.statement: Residual source scope: after the paid whole-source pencil alternatives of rate_half_mca_regular_rational_plane_terminal_bounds are removed; if one occurs, use its whole-source payment instead. For original KoalaBear rank12 J9965..21499 and actual P2 rank19, every seven-anchor pencil-free pair/shared enclosure5/4 with primitive normalization nu<=H=floor((J1-1)/10) has original raw-t weight<=1048577*L_t/(67473-t), t=1,2. All actual degrees and unused slack are covered by26 exact graded prices and1208 child certificates. Excess forces a seven-anchor enclosure with a rank-one F-plane, or nu>H and an actual normalization jump among the first seven anchors. An enclosure plane need not be occupied. No unrestricted rank19, whole degree, row or Prize closes.
